QUOTE: approved = auto_approve_tools || ServerManager::is_explicitly_allowed (allow list)
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the allow list only skips the prompt and shows it consulted in `check_approval`, but it never states that the allow list does not grant execution. It also never says `check_approval` is the only place the allow list is read. It also names no separate file for that check.
